title: A Day at the Park
text:
We go to the park in spring. The park has a big slide and a green swing. My sister likes the slide. I like the swing.

In winter the park is quiet. There is snow on the grass. We make a snowman. Then we go home and drink warm milk.

options: A big slide and a green swing

questions.text: What do the children make in winter?
What can we infer about the writer?
options: The writer does not like the park
The writer is always at school

questions.text: Why do the children drink warm milk after they make the snowman?

vocabulary.definition: a public outdoor place with grass, trees and play equipment
a smooth surface that children go down for fun
white, cold pieces of frozen water that fall from the sky
the coldest season of the year

paragraph_translations: İlkbaharda parka gideriz. Parkta büyük bir kaydırak ve yeşil bir salıncak var. Kız kardeşim kaydırağı sever. Ben salıncağı severim.
Kışın park sessizdir. Çimlerin üzerinde kar var. Bir kardan adam yaparız. Sonra eve gidip sıcak süt içeriz.
